title: Ternary Perfect Forms Over Imaginary Quadratic Field
summary: In this work, we enumerate the ternary perfect forms over all imaginary quadratic fields of absolute discriminant up to $91$ and study the number and combinatorial types of their associated polytopes. We prove a bound on the number of combinatorial types that can arise regardless of the discriminant. We analyze the data and make several observations concerning the number and complexity of the perfect forms that arise in the scope of our calculation.
